nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Package-level agent guide for the web package, deferring general rules to the root AGENTS.md. Documents two share-page invariants: the WebSocket message conversion gate in Share.tsx (V1 messages detected via 'metadata' in content, V2 shell messages bypassing fromV1) and the exact BashTool state shape (state.input.command, state.metadata.output, state.metadata.description) expected by part.tsx.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Boilerplate Starlight starter-kit README retained from the 'npm create astro' template, describing the Astro/Starlight project structure (src/content/docs routing, public assets) and the npm dev/build/preview commands. Contains no project-specific guidance beyond the template.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for @opencode-ai/web, the Astro/Starlight docs and session-share site. Defines astro dev/build scripts (including a dev:remote variant pointing at api.opencode.ai) and dependencies on @astrojs/starlight, solid-js, shiki, marked, and workspace packages @opencode-ai/diff-wasm and opencode, with catalog: version pinning managed by the Bun workspace.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun workspace conventions: catalog: for shared version pinning and workspace:* for monorepo-internal dependencies.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the web package, extending Astro's strict preset over all sources except dist. Preserves JSX and sets jsxImportSource to solid-js so .tsx files compile as SolidJS components rather than React.
nodes.languageNotes: jsx: preserve with jsxImportSource: solid-js is the standard Astro + SolidJS integration setup; 'preserve' lets the Astro/Vite pipeline handle the JSX transform.
